 NextGen Healthcare Appoints Anthony Palladino as Chief Financial Officer
 October 23, 2026 
 Anthony Palladino 
 NextGen Healthcare , a Detroit-based provider of cloud-based healthcare technology solutions, has appointed Anthony Palladino as Chief Financial Officer, bringing more than 30 years of financial and operational leadership experience in enterprise software and technology to the company.
 Palladino joins NextGen Healthcare from Thoma Bravo, where he served as an operating partner, working with portfolio company leadership teams to strengthen financial operations, improve operating efficiency and support profitable growth across the private equity firm’s software investments.
 Previously, Palladino served as Chief Financial Officer of Elemica, a private equity-backed provider of cloud-based digital supply network solutions for global process industries. In that role, he led the company’s finance organization during a period of growth and value creation.
 “We are excited to welcome Tony to our leadership team and look forward to the expertise and perspective he will bring as we continue to transform ambulatory healthcare and deliver meaningful innovation for our clients,” said Srinivas (Sri) Velamoor , President and CEO of NextGen Healthcare.
 Velamoor cited Palladino’s experience in software-as-a-service, private equity, healthcare and financial management, along with his existing familiarity with NextGen Healthcare’s operations and customers.
 Palladino previously worked closely with NextGen Healthcare during his tenure at Thoma Bravo, providing him with direct knowledge of the company’s technology platform and business operations.
 “Having worked closely with NextGen Healthcare and many other software businesses during my time at Thoma Bravo, I’ve seen firsthand the strength of this team, its client relationships and its platform,” Palladino said.
 He said his priorities will include strengthening the company’s finance organization, improving operational performance and supporting sustainable, profitable growth.
 Palladino holds a Bachelor of Science in Business Administration and Finance from Drexel University and a Master of Business Administration from Pennsylvania State University.
 NextGen Healthcare provides integrated technology solutions for ambulatory medical practices, supporting clinical workflows, practice operations and financial management.
 The appointment adds financial and operational leadership experience as the company continues developing its healthcare technology platform and supporting the business needs of outpatient care providers.
